result.summary: This is a residential street with row houses and sidewalks provided on both sides of the roadway. While the environment appears to be low-speed, it lacks marked pedestrian crossings and features sightline obstructions due to on-street parking.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb can block the view of pedestrians, particularly children, from oncoming drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no designated, marked areas for pedestrians to cross the street safely, which may lead to unpredictable crossing behavior.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian paths and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at potential crossing points to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near intersections or crossing points to ensure clear sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.
